text: By the light of a candle. <break time="0.8s" /> He arranged her hair. <break time="0.8s" /> Finished her simple dressing. <break time="0.8s" /> Tied her wrists with a ribbon. <break time="0.8s" /> And laid the body on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he sat down at the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Laid his arms upon it. <break time="0.8s" /> And dropped his face into them. <break time="0.8s" /> Still tearless and unutterably weary. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment a long, wailing sound. <break time="0.8s" /> Like the cry of a lost child. <break time="0.8s" /> Came through the open window. <break time="0.8s" /> From the far depths of the darkening wood. <break time="0.8s" /> But the man did not move. <break time="0.8s" /> And he did not hear it. <break time="0.8s" /> For Murlock. <break time="0.8s" /> Worn out by three days of nursing and grief. <break time="0.8s" /> Was fast asleep. <break time="0.8s" /> Some hours later. <break time="0.8s" /> He lifted his head from his arms. <break time="0.8s" /> And listened intently. <break time="0.8s" /> Though he could not tell. <break time="0.8s" /> What sound had awakened him. <break time="0.8s" /> He strained his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> In the black darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> And silently asked himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Who or what had waked him. <break time="0.8s" /> And where it could be now. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the table shook. <break time="0.8s" /> Beneath his arms. <break time="0.8s" /> And at the same moment. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard, or thought he heard. <break time="0.8s" /> A light, soft step upon the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> Then came another step. <break time="0.8s" /> And then sounds. <break time="0.8s" /> As of bare feet moving softly. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the wooden floor of the dark cabin.
